result.brief: 提出 Quantum-JEPA：用条件量子 Born 先验生成二值潜动作，共享预测器映射到多模态未来表征，避免指数级类别输出层，并在 D3IL 与真实 QPU 上验证多路径未来预测。
result.reason: Latent-action JEPA world model learning distributions of future representations; quantum Born prior replaces categorical latent-action head, directly a representation/world-model contribution.
